test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following instruments is used to measure the resistance of an earthing electrode?
solution:
__**Concept**__

**Why earthing resistance must be measured:**

__
 
• Earthing provides a safe path for fault current.
 
• Low earth resistance ensures: Proper operation of protective devices and Safety of equipment and personnel
 
• Hence, earth resistance must be accurately measured.
 
• **The Earth Tester or Megger Earth Tester is used to measure the resistance of an earthing electrode.**

**​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Power analyser:** Used to measure voltage, current, power, power factor, harmonics — not earth resistance

**Tachometer: **Measures the rotational speed (RPM) of machines

**Clamp meter: **Measures current (and sometimes voltage), not earth resistance
